metadata.title: Micron Stock Jumps as Intel CEO Warns On Memory Chips<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Why Micron Stock Is Jumping as Intel CEO Warns On Memory Chips
Micron Technology stock was back on the rise early Thursday. A warning from the head of Intel about soaring memory prices looks to be reminding shareholders of the company’s profit potential.
